## Description
Hair, braids, nails, pedicure, lashes & wig services in Lekki Phase 1, Lagos. Book your collection, stylist and time online.

## Services
- Wig Styling (bring your own wig)
- Wig Customization (natural finish, lace tint, plucking)
- Wig Installation (professional, secure)
- Wig Wash & Revival / Restoration
- Nail Art (custom designs)
- Manicure + Pedicure combo
- Gel / Long-lasting nail finishes
- Pedicure (grooming, shaping, cuticle care, exfoliation)

## Booking FAQs (12 — booking-only)
Q: Can I bring my own wig for styling?
A: Yes. You can bring your own wig for selected services, including styling and customization at Veebeez, Lekki Phase 1.

Q: Do you customize wigs?
A: Yes. Depending on the wig, customization can include adjustments and styling to create a more natural, personalized finish.

Q: Can you install my wig?
A: Yes. Our wig services can include professional installation for a secure and polished look.

Q: Can you wash and revive an old wig?
A: Yes, depending on its condition. We can assess your wig and recommend suitable restoration, washing, treatment, or styling services.

Q: How do I choose the right wig?
A: Our team can help you select a wig based on your preferred style, length, texture, colour, and desired level of maintenance.

Q: Do you offer nail art?
A: Yes. You can request customized nail art and designs. More detailed designs may require additional time.

Q: Can I get a manicure and pedicure during the same visit?
A: Yes. You can combine services where scheduling allows. We recommend booking in advance so enough time can be reserved.

Q: Do you offer gel or long-lasting nail finishes?
A: Yes, selected long-lasting nail finishes are available. Our nail professionals can recommend the most suitable option.

Q: Can I come with existing polish or extensions?
A: Yes, but removal may be required before your new service. Please mention this when booking so the appropriate time can be allocated.

Q: What does a pedicure include?
A: A pedicure typically includes nail grooming, shaping, cuticle care, exfoliation, and finishing. Specific treatments may vary by package.

Q: Can I book a pedicure without getting my nails done?
A: Absolutely. You can book a pedicure as a standalone service.

Q: How often should I get a pedicure?
A: This depends on your personal preference and foot-care needs. Many clients schedule regular appointments every 3–4 weeks.
